caption:
We treat motivation like fuel that should arrive before we start — but it usually shows up after. The people who keep going aren't more inspired; they've just made starting smaller and quitting harder. On the days you don't feel like it, lower the bar instead of dropping the habit. What does your ten-minute version look like?
